basis: Ocular motility disorder; vestibular or central causes do not establish additional organ damage for this concept.
Phalangeal hypoplasia and joint/bone fusion define disease; absent nails in 80-99%; hearing loss and hypermetropia only 5-29%.
Cobalamin metabolic defect with anemia and intellectual disability in 80-99%; retinal/optic damage 30-79%; renal and oral involvement omitted by cap.
Bordetella infection of respiratory epithelium causes a pertussis-like airway disease.
Clonal myeloid/dendritic-cell neoplasm; a destructive solitary bone lesion is the usual unifocal presentation (>50%).
Immune-mediated inflammatory degeneration of skeletal muscle; dysphagia reflects swallowing-muscle dysfunction without separate GI tissue damage.
Foveal hypoplasia, cataract and optic atrophy define ocular disease; hyperpigmentation alone does not establish damaging skin disease.
Localized lower-limb peripheral nerve disease; neuritis alone does not establish an autoimmune or infectious mechanism.
Malignant smooth-muscle tumor arising within the CNS; tumor origin determines the organ axis.
Inherited defective dental enamel; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Arthropathy affects joints; this concept does not encompass all systemic manifestations of progeria.
Inherited ventricular dilation and myocardial dysfunction; extracardiac disease in selected syndromic subtypes does not characterize the umbrella.
Purely psychiatric anxiety and depressive disorder; no qualifying organ axis.
Papillary urothelial carcinoma originates in the urinary bladder, included in the renal axis.
Acute myeloid leukemia defined by a KMT2A/MLLT1-associated translocation; no common additional organ damage established.
Extrahepatic bile-duct obliteration with cholestatic liver injury and fibrosis; bile ducts and gallbladder are hepatic.
Personality disorder without defining damage to any of the 13 organ axes.
PEX14-related Zellweger-spectrum disorder; brain dysfunction, liver disease and hearing loss commonly exceed 30%; ocular disease omitted by cap.
Mature B-cell lymphoma; both blood-cell lineage and the lymphoma mechanism axis apply. No defining extranodal site.
Immune-mediated eosinophilic inflammation damages gastrointestinal tissue; tissue eosinophilia does not itself establish a blood disorder.
Immune dysregulation, autoimmune endocrinopathy and enteropathy define IPEX; chronic eczematous dermatitis in 97/116 (~84%).
Malignancy of the uterine corpus or cervix; reproductive organs have no axis. Spread to other organs is not defining.
Skeletal dysplasia and lipodystrophy; skin atrophy 80-99%, dental abnormalities 30-79%; renal failure reported in 1/1, population frequency uncertain.
Forebrain malformation; cleft palate 3/4; hypothalamic-pituitary dysfunction/DI common in classic HPE (~50-70%); structural eye defects 1/4 excluded.
Atrial electrical dysfunction defines the disease; stroke is a separately diagnosed complication, not intrinsic neurologic involvement.
